proof_summary: Introduce the companion Lucas sequence \(V_0=2, V_1=-2, V_{n+2}=-2V_{n+1}-16V_n\), and realize it through \((-1+\sqrt{-15})^n\); the multiplication and norm identities then give the duplication formula \(V_n^2=V_{2n}+2\cdot16^n\). A recurrence comparison establishes \(2a_n=2^nV_{n+1}+2^{3n+2}(1-(-1)^n)\), and at odd indices the duplication formula makes the extra power-of-two terms cancel, leaving the explicit square \((2^nV_{n+1})^2\).
